overview_description.description: Nourish is a healthcare technology company that connects patients with registered dietitians through virtual nutrition counseling services covered by insurance plans. The platform allows users to find dietitians based on their health goals and attend appointments through telehealth, while also offering tools for meal tracking, goal monitoring, and nutrition guidance through its mobile application. Nourish works with registered dietitian nutritionists who provide support for conditions such as diabetes, weight management, cardiovascular health, eating disorders, and pediatric nutrition care. The company states that it partners with major insurance providers to reduce out-of-pocket costs for patients and offers ongoing nutritional care through recurring consultations. In addition to patient services, Nourish publishes educational resources and uses data-driven approaches to support personalized nutrition planning and long-term health management.

product.name: Insurance-Covered Virtual Nutrition Counseling
product.description: Personalized nutrition counseling delivered by Registered Dietitian Nutritionists through telehealth and billed to participating insurance plans in all 50 states.

product.name: Nourish App
product.description: A patient mobile application that supports nutrition care between appointments through meal logging, goal tracking, dietitian messaging, session summaries, and meal recommendations.

product.name: Clinical Nutrition Labwork
product.description: Periodic labwork access integrated with nutrition care to help patients and dietitians monitor clinical measures and adjust care plans.

product.name: GLP-1 Nutrition Support
product.description: Nutrition counseling for patients starting, using, or discontinuing GLP-1 medications, focused on eating habits, side-effect management, adherence, and maintaining results after treatment.

identifier.value: Nutrition Care for Health Plans and Employers

product.name: Nutrition Care for Health Plans and Employers
product.description: A virtual nutrition-care solution for health plans and employer populations, combining dietitian services, patient technology, outcome tracking, and insurance or benefits integration.

identifier.value: Medically Tailored Meal and Grocery Delivery

product.name: Medically Tailored Meal and Grocery Delivery
product.description: An in-app ordering service that allows eligible patients or members to obtain dietitian-approved medically tailored meals and groceries to support nutrition care plans.
